ai-translator.dashboard.infoMessage: Whenever you add new content, run auto-translation with Incremental mode enabled, only new untranslated strings are processed. This allows you to keep manual translations while still benefiting from AI translation for new content. Our AI translator understands context, supports 165 languages, preserves formatting and structure, and follows grammar and plural form rules. It produces natural, human-like translations.
